description: This file defines a Retrofit interface for interacting with product-related API endpoints in a Kotlin frontend application. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products, utilizing suspend functions for asynchronous network calls. The interface uses DTO classes for request and response payloads.

classes.name: ProductApi
classes.description: A Retrofit interface defining API endpoints for product management, including methods for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting products.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products with optional filters such as query, category, sort order, and price range.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product using provided DTO data.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product identified by ID.
